sources.shortCitation: Stare Melodie, “Może tak, może nie” — Columbia DM 1624 a (1932)
sources.fullCitation: Stare Melodie. “Może tak, może nie.” Polish-language song entry with words by Julian Tuwim, linked there to “Gib nur acht, über Nacht kommt die Liebe”; recording by Zofia Terné, Columbia DM 1624 a, matrix WJ 277, 1932. The page groups Fritz Rotter and Bronisław Kaper under music; the work credits here follow the contemporary German registrations, which assign the music to Kaper and the German words to Rotter. Accessed 9 August 2026.
sources.title: Może tak, może nie — Polish version and Columbia recording
sources.creator: Stare Melodie
